head: fd28ae84b5a9c573b4db1e22f8db7881be8e5cbc
title: fix(coach-ai): AI meal plans generate, AI programs never claim an assignment, no dead Ask AI pill (AUDIT-14-125)
body:
Tier: T3
Why: coach AI surfaces (AI meal plan request body, AI program approval copy, the Ask AI entry point); a wrong change could send a client's allergy information to the model incorrectly or mislead a coach about what reached the client.
T4 trigger scan: none (no auth, RLS/tenancy, money, credentials or destructive data; client data sent to the model is unchanged: allergies and dietary restrictions still travel in `notes`, as they already did; consent gating is server-side and untouched).
T3 trigger scan: AI request contract (POST /coach/ai/meal-plan body) and customer-facing AI copy.
Bounded T1: NO (AI surface, three files of product behaviour).
Canonical builder: Claude Opus 5.5 (AUDIT-14-125, agent 125)
Parent owner: operator agent 125
Acceptance evidence: `src/__tests__/coachAi.test.tsx` new case (meal-plan body has only clientId/days/notes, allergies inside notes; fails on main, where the body carries `allergies` and `dietary_restrictions`); `src/utils/coach/__tests__/aiWorkoutApproveCopy.test.ts` (no "assigned" claim without a backend `assigned_count`). Full suite + tsc in this PR's CI.
Promotion triggers: any change to what client data reaches the model, or to the approval/decision endpoints.

Works against the CURRENT production backend (ec12a4b3): no new endpoint is called; the approve copy reads an optional `assigned_count` that production does not send, so it falls back to the truthful "saved to library" text.

## Fixes

**B1 — AI workout program "Approve & assign" claims an assignment that never happens.** A coach taps Generate workout program, then Approve & assign, sees "Workout program assigned to Sam", but the backend (`CoachAIService.materializeWorkoutProgram`, src/ai/coach/coach-ai.service.ts) only creates unassigned workout plans in the coach's library, so Sam never receives anything and the coach believes he did. Fix: the button reads "Approve"; the alert says "The program is saved to your workout library. Sam does not see it until it is assigned." and says "N workouts assigned to Sam" only if a future backend returns `assigned_count > 0` (operator item: backend auto-assign).

**U1 — every AI meal plan generation fails with a 400.** A coach taps Generate meal plan, then Generate, and always gets an error: the app sends `allergies` and `dietary_restrictions` as body keys, and the backend `GenerateMealPlanDto` (global ValidationPipe, `forbidNonWhitelisted: true`, src/main.ts:97-103) refuses any undeclared key. Fix: send only clientId, days and notes; the allergies and restrictions were already mirrored into `notes` (unchanged), so the model still sees them.

**U2 — Ask AI pill dead-ends.** A coach taps Ask AI on a client's Summary tab, drafts a check-in nudge, lands on Pending AI drafts, and Approve/Reject silently do nothing: the gateway stores the coach as the draft's requester and `AiApprovalService.decide` refuses a decision by the requester (403, src/ai/gateway/ai-approval.service.ts:92-94), and the screen has no error state. The coach's own Nudge button already sends the same push directly. Fix: the pill is not shown (SummaryTab renders it only when a caller wires it; ClientDetailScreen no longer does). The sheet copy issues (first person "What should I help you draft", visible developer note about a follow-up) go away with it.

## Overlap
`src/screens/coach/ClientDetailScreen.tsx` and `src/screens/coach/client-detail/SummaryTab.tsx` are also touched by m#404 (FOOD-COACH-124). This PR changes only the `onOpenAskAi` prop line, one comment, and the Ask AI pill block; m#404 changes the SummaryTab props/calorie card. Expected to merge cleanly in either order.

Size: 174 changed lines (139 + 35), tests included.

Fixes (one-sentence user stories in the PR body):
- B1: AI workout program approval no longer tells the coach "assigned to <client>" when the backend only saved library plans; copy switches to "N workouts assigned" only when a backend returns assigned_count > 0.
- U1: AI meal plan generation no longer 400s (body is clientId/days/notes; allergies and restrictions stay in notes as before).
- U2: the Ask AI pill (check-in nudge drafts the coach can never approve: requester self-decide 403) is no longer shown.

Works against the current production backend. Overlap: ClientDetailScreen.tsx and SummaryTab.tsx are also touched by m#404 (different hunks).
